contractSource: Description: "Interactive HSL color picker with live preview, format conversion..." Hue input and slider run from 0 to 360.
groundTruth: HSL→RGB (CSS Color 4): hue is an angle, so 360° is the same colour as 0°. hsl(0/360, 100%, 50%) = rgb(255, 0, 0) = #FF0000; hsl(210, 50%, 40%) = #336699.

cases.derivation: Hue is an angle: 360° ≡ 0°. hsl(360°, 100%, 50%) is therefore pure red: C = 1, X = 0, m = 0 → (255, 0, 0) = #FF0000. The slider's maximum is 360, so users reach this value by dragging to the end.
